bio: It may be a former prison whose name means fortress, but you can’t feel more carefree than when seated on the sheltered terrace eating brasserie classics like burgers or moules frites and looking out over the water to Aker Brygge. The period building decorated in light wood tones is charming too though, with a smart yet cosy feel, and the team will welcome you just as warmly wherever you sit. The modern restaurant menu offers unfussy, attractively presented dishes like hamachi crudo with marinated cucumber, yuzu vinaigrette and horseradish or grilled chicken supreme with rosemary oil and spinach.
